knowledgeDocuments.title: Cloud Infrastructure FinOps Directive (FY25/26)
knowledgeDocuments.content: According to the internal Cloud Architecture Strategy, all non-production Kubernetes clusters must implement scheduled node downscaling during off-peak hours (20:00 - 07:00 UTC). Production workloads utilize 3-year reserved instances with automated spot-instance fallback for ephemeral batch jobs, targeting an annualized cloud spend reduction of 22%. All compute expansion exceeding $5,000/mo requires VP Engineering sign-off.

knowledgeDocuments.title: Enterprise Customer Onboarding SOP (Rev 4.2)
knowledgeDocuments.content: Enterprise customer onboarding requires mandatory IdP-initiated SAML 2.0 / OIDC configuration, SCIM-based provisioning, and mutual TLS for webhook integrations. A designated Customer Success Architect must conduct a tenant isolation audit before production data ingestion commences. All client data must be tagged with appropriate data classification tags (Confidential / Restricted).

knowledgeDocuments.title: Telemetry Report: US-East-1 API Latency & Edge Caching
knowledgeDocuments.content: Query against SNOWFLAKE://TELEMETRY.EDGE.P99_LATENCY shows nominal performance across us-east-1 (P50: 24ms, P99: 142ms). Zero anomalies detected in the last 24-hour monitoring window. Semantic caching hit ratio is currently operating at 41.2% with a 0% stale-read occurrence.

knowledgeDocuments.title: Gemini Enterprise Zero-Retention Acceptable Use Policy
knowledgeDocuments.content: All requests processed by Google Antigravity and Gemini Enterprise models are governed by the Enterprise Zero-Retention Protocol. Prompt and response payloads are processed exclusively in ephemeral memory and are never retained for model re-training or shared across tenant boundaries. Outbound calls to external LLMs outside authorized VPC endpoints are blocked by enterprise firewall rules.
